rows.Kwic: 問：「悟道雪山成話柄，惟明生死絕淆訛，曾聞兜率三關語，還許即今請益麼？」師云：「一一問將來。」

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Fushi (浮石禪師語錄): an unnamed monk asks Fushi Tongxian for permission to inquire about Doushuai Congyue's three barriers, then proceeds through the three questions. The line, expanded context, section header, book title, TEI header, and parallel-passage search do not give a personal name for the unnamed monk.

rows.Kwic: 本參公案急要翻身，胸次疑團直須打破

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Fushi (浮石禪師語錄): in his end-of-retreat informal address, Fushi Tongxian tells the assembly urgently to turn around at its primary public case and break the ball of doubt in the breast.

rows.Kwic: 光影門頭休駐足，色聲叢裡好撐睛。

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Fushi (浮石禪師語錄): in his verse replying to the layman Shen Shuding, Fushi Tongxian says not to halt at the gate of light and shadow and to open the eyes amid the thicket of forms and sounds.
